answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is time-locked collateral plus a vouch graph. A new identity locks a deposit in the juniper contract for a maturation window, forfeitable if flagged. To mature sooner it needs attestations from established non-kin peers, each a sonnet-sized signed statement binding its key to a verified operator. Forged identities cluster into cliques that graph analysis detects and slashes together. The cost is a thousand locked deposits plus vouch capital, all forfeited on exposure. Promising Sybil-proof identity without this is selling a fable.
